summary: Completed comprehensive testing of FoeGuard Dog/Cat pet selector and collection banners. All features working perfectly including pet selector buttons, coming soon message, collection banners, and mobile responsiveness.
passed_tests: Dog/Cat selector appears at top of build-box page
Raw Dog Food button with dog image is clickable and shows checkmark when selected
Raw Cat Food button with cat image is clickable and shows checkmark when selected
Selecting Cat shows 'Cat Food Coming Soon' message with Notify Me button
Selecting Dog shows full box builder with products
Comfort Dinner collection has banner image with text overlay
Primal Feast collection has banner image with text overlay
Product cards display correctly under each collection (16 cards found)
Mobile responsive design works for pet selector
All images load correctly from external CDN
Pet selector buttons maintain proper spacing on mobile (side by side)
Checkmarks display correctly on both desktop and mobile
Coming soon message and Notify Me button work on mobile
Collection banners and product cards responsive on mobile
